passages.quote:
This code provides statutory guidance on access and unfair practices during the trade union recognition and derecognition processes, as well as changes to the bargaining unit.

It covers:

a union’s right to request access to workers from the point when the Central Arbitration Committee (CAC) notifies that it has accepted a relevant application

what access could be considered reasonable and what practical steps both the employer and the union can take

avoiding unfair practices from the point when the CAC notifies that it has accepted a relevant application
